tiers.everyday: The World Peace Bell in Newport, Kentucky, cast by Paccard in France, weighs 33 tonnes. It was made to ring in the year 2000.
tiers.student: Paccard's portfolio gives 1999 as the year of casting and 33 metric tons; other accounts give December 1998 (not verified). It was installed at Newport for the millennium. Present status [UNKNOWN].
